title: Mystic Guide in Lavender Field
description: A surreal black and white line drawing shows a giant three-faced female figure with multiple eyes standing in a starry night sky above a mountain range. In the foreground, a hiker with a backpack and walking stick follows a path through a vibrant purple lavender field toward the towering mystical being who holds a crystal cluster in one hand and a swirling orb with a red planet in the other.
prompt: Surreal black and white line art illustration of a giant three-faced goddess with multiple glowing eyes, geometric body patterns, holding a crystal cluster in one hand and a swirling cosmic orb containing a red planet in the other. She stands against a starry night sky with mountains and constellations. In the foreground, a lone hiker with backpack and walking stick walks along a path through a vibrant purple lavender field toward the towering figure. Detailed ink drawing with selective color on the flowers and celestial elements.
